description: Per-platform submission playbook for the launchdesk destination catalog. One JSON file per destination, named <registrable-domain>.json (e.g. producthunt.com.json). All claims must come from public pages cited in sources[]; never assert an observed submission. Grade vocabulary: 'researched' = assembled from public docs/submission pages read on `retrieved`; 'observed' = a real submission run was witnessed (only set by the owning pipeline, never by research agents).

fields.name: display name
fields.retrieved: ISO date the sources were read
fields.category: launch-board | directory | ai-directory | review | community | profile | other
fields.zeroCostRoute: free | conditional | paid | unknown — conditional means the free path has a gate (badge, DR floor, account age, queue)
conditions: only when zeroCostRoute=conditional: what the free path requires
requirements: eligibility/fit rules found on the site (B2B only, working product, etc.)
preparation: assets/facts to gather before opening the form
workflow: ordered submission steps an agent can follow
watchFor: form quirks, upsells, traps, honesty constraints
fields.countsAsLive: the observable condition proving the listing is live (not draft/scheduled)
unknowns: things public pages did not answer — keep honest, never guess
